hardware_used: Laptop, AMD/Intel CPU + NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 Laptop GPU (CPU-only training)
notes: Zero-inflated median model: 24.4% of SuperCon labels are exactly Tc=0, and MAE is minimised by the conditional median, not the conditional mean. A LightGBM P(Tc=0) classifier gates an ensemble of positive-part regressors (matminer/Magpie + superconductivity-physics descriptors: charge-balanced cuprate hole doping with the Presland-Tallon dome, Matthias valence-electron rules, isotope-effect mass proxies). All model selection by 5-fold CV on the official train split only; the official test split was evaluated exactly once.
